ITEM 1 | Square white plate, roughly 26 cm across, used as the reference scale; food covers most of the plate surface. | 0
ITEM 2 | Flatbread-like piece, pale cream-beige with golden-browned edges and light char spots, folded over with a bright orange-red glossy sauce smeared on top and a yellow-tan crumbly edge; about 9 cm long by 6 cm wide, roughly 1.5 cm thick at the fold, sitting on green pepper strips. | 110
ITEM 3 | Bright red-orange glossy sauce spread over the top of the flatbread piece, thick and slightly wet-looking, about 4 cm by 3 cm patch. | 25
ITEM 4 | Shredded pale pink-beige meat mixture with green herb flecks and a few darker bits, moist and clumpy, lightly sheened, mounded beside the flatbread; roughly 6 cm by 4 cm, about 2 cm high. | 70
ITEM 5 | Bright green pepper strips, glossy, firm, cut into thick slices 4–6 cm long and about 1 cm wide, scattered under and around the flatbread and along the left edge of the plate. | 45
ITEM 6 | Browned meat chunks, medium brown with darker seared edges and visible green herb specks, dense and slightly glossy, cut into irregular pieces about 2–3 cm across, clustered in the upper middle of the plate. | 80
ITEM 7 | Cubed golden-brown potatoes, crisp-looking edges with some pale interior, cut into roughly 2–3 cm irregular cubes, several pieces scattered across the upper right and right side of the plate, with a few small green herb flecks. | 90
